decisions_for_aj: Davis-Monthan AMARG boneyard (Tucson): thousands of aircraft, but it's on an active base. Excluded by policy and not used. Include it or not?

Pima's west edge borders Valencia Armory (AZ National Guard, OSM military=base). Under our 150 m buffer, a 230 m photo needs the aircraft to be at least 265 m from it; see policy.clear_for_230m_photo. Allow tighter framing (armory out of frame but closer than 150 m), or keep the strict buffer?
Labels are type families for players (e.g. 'B-52', not 'B-52D'); D and G models aren't tellable from above at this resolution.
